title: Metal veneers.
officialText:
Veneers of metal shall be fabricated from approved corrosion-resistant materials or shall be protected front
and back with porcelain enamel, or otherwise be treated to render the metal resistant to corrosion. Such veneers shall not be less
than 0.0149-inch (0.378 mm) nominal thickness sheet steel mounted on wood or metal furring strips or approved sheathing on the
wood construction.
